name: secret-guard
description: Keeps secrets out of Claude's context: gitleaks scans every tool output, prompt and attachment before the model reads it, and you decide what the model sees.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the dialogs, pane and notices: en or ru. What the model reads is always English.

keywordRules.title: Keyword rules
keywordRules.description: Also catch what gitleaks' default rules miss in a conversation: a value after пароль / password / token / secret (English and Russian), a password in a URL, a Bearer token, sk-proj- keys.

entropyRule.title: Entropy rule
entropyRule.description: Also catch long random-looking tokens with no known shape, by their Shannon entropy (about 93% of random 20-64 character tokens; some noise on minified code).

wordRule.title: Random words in prompts
wordRule.description: Also catch a random-looking word of 8 characters or more in your own prompt (a password typed with nothing around it), by how often its kind of character changes: about 75% of such passwords, a dialog on 0.2% of ordinary prompts. Prompts up to 2000 characters only: on code and pastes it would be too noisy.
